If the tool broke because SLT changed their API, please use the **MySLT API change** template
instead. Typical signs of that are a login failure, a usage fetch failure, or a message about
not being able to parse the usage response.

**Redact real values before posting:** password, tokens, subscriber ID, account number, phone
number.
